question: Generate a pie chart to show the distribution of cancer grades across all patients.

files.eval_guideline: Pie chart must show proportional slices with percentage labels for each cancer grade; color scheme and font may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The filenames are identical, and both paths indicate PNG images. The name directly matches the requested pie chart showing cancer grade distribution across all patients.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires proportional slices and percentage labels for each cancer grade while allowing colors and fonts to differ. Semantic comparison evaluates these visual requirements without requiring pixel-level agreement.

comparison_details.explanation: Both pie charts show identical cancer grade distributions: Grade I 24.2%, Grade II 29.2%, Grade III 35.0%, and Grade IV 11.7%.
